title: vla-eval: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.13966v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly evaluated across multiple simulation benchmarks, yet adding each benchmark to an evaluation pipeline requires resolving incompatible dependencies, matching underspecified evaluation protocols, and reverse-engineering undocumented preprocessing. This burden scales with the number of models and benchmarks, making comprehensive evaluation impractical for most teams. We present vla-eval, an open-source evaluation harness that eliminates this per-benchmark cost by decoupling model inference from benchmark execution through a WebSocket+msgpack protocol with Docker-based environment isolation. Models integrate once by implementing a single predict() method; benchmarks integrate once via a four-method interface; the full cross-evaluation matrix works automatically. translated_title: vla-eval：视觉-语言-动作模型的统一评估框架
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型越来越多地在多个仿真基准上进行评估，然而，将每个基准添加到评估流程中需要解决不兼容的依赖关系、匹配定义不明确的评估协议，并对未记录的预处理过程进行逆向工程。这一负担随着模型和基准数量的增加而不断增长，使得全面评估对大多数团队来说变得不切实际。我们提出了vla-eval，一个开源评估框架，它通过WebSocket+msgpack协议和基于Docker的环境隔离，将模型推理与基准执行解耦，从而消除了每个基准的集成成本。模型只需实现一个predict()方法即可完成集成；基准通过四方法接口完成集成；完整的交叉评估矩阵即可自动运行。该框架支持14个仿真基准和六个模型服务器，并通过回合分片和批量推理实现并行评估。
tldr: vla-eval是一个开源统一评估框架，通过WebSocket+msgpack协议和Docker环境隔离将模型推理与基准执行解耦，模型与基准各只需一次集成，即可自动支持14个仿真基准与多个模型服务器之间的完整交叉评估。
en_tdlr: vla-eval is an open-source unified evaluation harness that decouples model inference from benchmark execution via a WebSocket+msgpack protocol with Docker-based isolation, allowing models and benchmarks to integrate once and automatically enabling full cross-evaluation across 14 simulation benchmarks and multiple model servers.
